column2: you choose separately for each Dragon creature you control whether or not to redirect the damage
column3: Outdated: this 2010-06-15 ruling applied the planeswalker redirection rule (CR 306.7 of its time: "If noncombat damage would be dealt to a player by a source controlled by an opponent, that opponent may have that source deal that damage to a planeswalker the first player controls instead."), removed by the Dominaria Comprehensive Rules (effective 2018-04-27; current CR 306.7: "This rule has been removed and certain cards have received errata in the Oracle card reference to deal damage directly to planeswalkers."). Sarkhan the Mad's −4 now reads "target player or planeswalker", so there is nothing to redirect; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md; the current behavior is tested in tests/rulings/r_p008_planeswalkers.rs (sarkhan_the_mad_dragons_damage_the_target_with_no_redirection)

column2: If you can't choose a target opponent when you put Manticore of the Gauntlet's triggered ability on the stack
column3: Outdated in part: written 2017-04-18 (the Amonkhet release notes, 2017-04-14) for the printed text "Manticore of the Gauntlet deals 3 damage to target opponent."; the Dominaria Oracle update (Dominaria Oracle Changes, 2018-04-13, which went with the Comprehensive Rules effective 2018-04-27 that removed planeswalker damage redirection) changed it to "target opponent or planeswalker", so with its opponents hexproof the ability can still target a planeswalker (its controller's too) and is put on the stack (CR 603.3d). What it says happens with no legal target (removed from the stack, no -1/-1 counter) still holds and is cited; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md; the current behavior is tested in tests/rulings/r_p008_targets.rs (manticore_of_the_gauntlet_targets_a_planeswalker_when_its_opponents_have_hexproof)

column2: The Fallen’s ability causes it to deal damage only to opponents of its current controller.
column3: Outdated in part: written 2007-09-16, before there were planeswalkers, for an ability that dealt damage only to opponents; the Dominaria Oracle update (Dominaria Oracle Changes, 2018-04-13, which went with the Comprehensive Rules effective 2018-04-27 that removed planeswalker damage redirection) gave it "each opponent and planeswalker it has dealt damage to this game", so it also deals damage to the planeswalkers it has dealt damage to, its current controller's included. The second sentence (a player it has dealt damage to who gains control of it isn't dealt damage) still holds and is cited; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md; the current behavior is tested in tests/rulings/r_p008_combat_lki.rs (the_fallen_damages_the_planeswalkers_it_has_dealt_damage_to)
